write_up: Your resume is excellent! It tells a clear story from clinic operations at Prairie Health System to leading Lakeshore Dental Partners across 140 practices. The growth, financial results and operating changes are concrete enough for a recruiter to see what you've led.

The new-practice integration line is a great model: it names the change you made and shows the time saved. Your executive responsibilities are also easy to grasp, with the practices, employees, revenue and board reporting right at the top.

Let's add what changed behind the shorter patient wait times and what you led in the Epic go-live. Otherwise, your resume isn't likely to be the thing standing between you and a call back. Competition and the match with a particular executive role will matter too.
